description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for evaluating system run policies and approval decisions related to executing commands, including handling allowlist misses, security restrictions, and user prompts.

methods.name: resolveExecApprovalDecision
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a defined ExecApprovalDecision string or null.

methods.name: formatSystemRunAllowlistMissMessage
methods.description: Generates a message string indicating an allowlist miss, with details about shell wrapper blocks.

methods.name: evaluateSystemRunPolicy
methods.description: Determines whether a system run is allowed based on security policies, user approval, and other parameters.
